skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply advanced programming techniques to develop management information systems in economic, management, and business administration fields.
Understand and apply object-oriented programming principles and techniques.
Understand and apply C++ programming language and its advanced features.
Understand and apply techniques for creating classes and objects in C++.
Understand and apply inheritance and polymorphism in object-oriented programming.
Develop skills in system development and deployment of intelligent systems.
Work independently or actively and effectively in group activities.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of management information systems.
